title: A machine learning-based model for predicting 5-year conditional survival in patients with colon cancer: a development and validation study
summary: A model predicts five-year conditional survival in a 430-patient colon-cancer cohort and is evaluated on an independent validation set. The study is retrospective and single-center. Author affiliations were not available in the reviewed publisher passages; organization left empty.
ai_technology: Six machine-learning methods and logistic regression
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
